info.name: TiQR API
info.description: Fill in `username` and `password`, run **Login** first, then the folders top to bottom. **[WRITE]** requests change data: use a test server. Everything but Health, Branding, Login, Session and the license reads needs an active license. Don't export with a password filled in.

variable.description: Server address. Use https:// if TLS is on.
Your password. Keep it blank in shared copies.
Set by Create service key. Used by the service-key requests.

request.description: No sign-in or license needed. **200** when ready; **503** if the database or scheduler is down.
No sign-in or license needed. App name, theme, languages, currencies and `has_logo`. **200**.
Needs sign-in: run **Login** first. Default timezone and whether server printing is on. **200**; **401**.
Sets the session cookie and saves `csrfToken`. **200**; **401** for wrong credentials; **429** when throttled.
The current user. **200**; **401** if the session ended.
Any role, even without a license. **200** with `state`, `is_valid` and `machine_id`.
Any role: a code to send the vendor. **200**.
Admins only: stored keys, newest first, mostly hidden. **200**; **403** otherwise.

item.name: Users
item.description: Listing: admin or manager. Changing users: admin only.

request.description: Admins and managers. **200**; **403** for operators. One page: `?page=1&size=10` (size up to 100).
Roles: `admin`, `manager`, `operator`; managers create operators only. Saves `newUserId`. Change the username if it exists already. **201**; **422** for a blank or taken username.
Admins only. **200**; **403** otherwise.
Blocks sign-in and ends their sessions. Managers may do this to operators. **200**.
Ends their sessions. **200**.

Admins only. Deletes a deactivated user only: after **Reactivate user** ran above, the account is active and this is refused with **409**. Run **Deactivate user** before this request; the account is then gone, so a later **Assign ticket** with `clerk` gets **404**. **204**; **409** if active or they created or hold tickets.

item.name: Catalog
item.description: Everyone reads; admins and managers change.

request.description: Every role may read. **200**. One page, by name: `?page=1&size=10`.
`price_minor` is in minor units (1250 is 12.50); `currency` must be one the server offers (see **Branding**). Saves `ticketTypeId`. **201**; **422** for a blank or taken name.
Any of `name`, `price_minor`, `currency`. **200**; **404** if gone.
Every role may read. **200**. One page, by name: `?page=1&size=10`.
`discount_percent` is 0 to 100. Saves `visitorTypeId`. **201**.
Any of `name`, `discount_percent`. **200**; **404** if gone.
Issued tickets keep their discount. **204**; **404** if gone.
Issued tickets keep their price. **204**; **404** if gone.

item.name: Tickets
item.description: Operators see and print only tickets assigned to them.

request.description: Operators see only tickets assigned to them. **200**. One page, newest first: `?page=1&size=10`. Also `?search=` (serial, visitor or type) and `?external_code=` (exact).
Filter by `state`: `issued`, `passed`, `expired` or `revoked`. **200**.

Saves `ticketId`. Times without an offset use `timezone`. Optional: `ticket_type`, `external_code`, `event_session`. Add an `Idempotency-Key` header to make a retry safe. **201**; **422** for bad input (or an unknown `ticket_type`); **409** if `external_code` is taken.
**200**; **403** for an operator if it isn't assigned to them.
Managers only (**403** for others). `assignee` is an existing, active username: run **Create user** and keep it active. **200**; **404** if it doesn't exist; **409** if it is deactivated.
Returns a PDF and counts as a print. Issued tickets only. **200**; **409** otherwise.

exec: pm.test('Printed, or printing is off', () => pm.expect([200, 409, 502]).to.include(pm.response.code));

request.description: Needs `TIQR_SERVER_PRINTING=true`. **200**; **409** when it's off; **502** if the printer fails.
Admins and managers; either end may be left out. Issued, or passed and multi-use, tickets only. **200**; **409** otherwise; **422** if the end is not after the start; **502** if BioStar fails.
Moves it to another `event_session`, keeping id, state and history. **200**; **409**; **502**.
Back to issued, as the same ticket; the window may move and must end in the future. Add an `Idempotency-Key` header to make a retry safe. **200**; **409**; **502**.
Admins and managers: every change, oldest first. **200**.

Uses `serviceKey` (from **Create service key**), not the session, so no CSRF token. `external_code` becomes the BioStar pass code unchanged: alphanumeric up to 32 characters, or 12 or 16 digits. Change the code if it is taken. **201**; **409** `external_code_taken`; **422** `credential_format`.
Same key and body as the request above: the first answer comes back, with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`, and no second pass is made in BioStar. **201** again.
The code is held by the pass above. **409** with `code` `external_code_taken`.
A code no reader accepts (a space inside). **422** with `code` `credential_format`; nothing is written.
Exact match on the code, to reconcile after a lost reply. Needs `tickets:read`. **200**.
Up to `TIQR_BATCH_MAX_SIZE` tickets. **200** with a result per item, unless the request is malformed. With `atomic` true, one failure undoes the rest (`rolled_back`, `skipped`).
Admins and managers. Cancels it and removes access in BioStar; revoking twice returns it unchanged. Run after the other ticket requests. **200**; **409** if expired; **502** if BioStar fails.

item.name: Service keys
item.description: Admins only, signed in with a session.

request.description: The `secret` is shown once. Saves `serviceKeyId` and `serviceKey`. **201**.
No secrets. **200**.
Issues a successor; the old key works on for `grace_minutes` (0 to 10080). **201**.
Ends the key at once. **200**; **404** if gone.

item.name: Operations
item.description: Admins and managers. The passage feed also accepts a service key with `tickets:read`.

request.description: Runs a BioStar sync now. **200** with `count`; **502** if BioStar fails.
Removes finished tickets from BioStar now. **200** with `count`; **502** if BioStar fails.

Passages in arrival order, one record per passage. Read by the `after` cursor (the `next_cursor` of the last page; 0 to start) and `limit` (1 to 500). Repeat with the same cursor to get the same records. Admins and managers, by session or by a service key with `tickets:read` (`Authorization: Bearer`, from an admin or manager account); operators get **403**. **200**.
Totals: `total`, `issued`, `passed`, `expired`, plus `visitor_types` and `ticket_types`. **200**.
The same figures, only for tickets created on these days in `TIQR_DEFAULT_TZ`; both ends are inclusive and either may be left out. **200**; **422** if the end is before the start.

item.name: Negative cases
item.description: These should fail. Run last: the wrong password counts toward the login limit.

request.description: **401**; **429** after 5 failures.
No `X-CSRF-Token` header. **403**.
Foreign `Origin` header. **403**.
Bad `valid_from`. **422**.
